title: A group of prime order is cyclic
statement: Let $p$ be prime and let $G$ be a group whose underlying set is finite [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set] with exactly $p$ elements. Then $G$ is cyclic: there is $g\in G$ such that every element of $G$ is $g^m$ for some integer $m$.
